messages.text: ZipCrypto now matches the reference, including auto-selection and password recovery. The remaining failure is isolated to the AES table: one standard substitution byte was omitted, causing key expansion to index a 255-byte table; I’m restoring that byte and then exercising all bundled AES/ZipCrypto fixtures plus an automated differential matrix.

$r=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $cases=@(@('--version'),@(),@('-i','missing.zip'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-w','0'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','--mask','?1?d'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-w','1','--mask','?d?d'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip','-w','1','--mask','?l?l'),@('-i','rust-reference/test-files/multi-file-with-dir.zip','-w','1','--fileNumber','99','--mask','a?l')); function InvokeCapture($exe,[string[]]$a,[bool]$py){$p=[Diagnostics.Process]::new();$p.StartInfo.FileName=$exe;$p.StartInfo.UseShellExecute=$false;$p.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput=$true;$p.StartInfo.RedirectStandardError=$true;if($py){$p.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add('./executable')};foreach($x in $a){$p.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add($x)};$p.Start()|Out-Null;$o=$p.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();$e=$p.StandardError.ReadToEnd();$p.WaitForExit();[pscustomobject]@{Code=$p.ExitCode;Out=($o -replace 'Time elapsed: [^\r\n]+','Time elapsed: <volatile>');Err=$e}}; $failed=0; foreach($a in $cases){$x=InvokeCapture $r $a $false;$y=InvokeCapture 'python' $a $true;if($x.Code-ne$y.Code-or$x.Out-ne$y.Out-or$x.Err-ne$y.Err){$failed++;"DIFF $($a-join ' ')`nREF=[$($x.Code)] O=<$($x.Out)> E=<$($x.Err)>`nPY =[$($y.Code)] O=<$($y.Out)> E=<$($y.Err)>"}}; "differential cases=$($cases.Count) failures=$failed"; if($failed){exit 1}
